- GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat all architectural geometry from the seed image as an immutable physical frame. Every column, window recess, sash mullion, cornice, balustrade, and ashlar stone course must remain razor-sharp and structurally intact. DO NOT melt, smooth, smear, or erase building elements.
- OPTICAL DEPTH: Render in pin-sharp deep focus / infinite depth of field (f/11 equivalent). Zero tilt-shift, zero lens blur across foreground and background.
- ILLUMINATION REPAINT: Completely discard seed image baked-in luminance. Repaint all cast shadows, highlights, and ambient bounce strictly according to the solar vector below.
- CANOPY RIGIDITY: Render foliage with distinct individual leaf clusters and crisp branch morphology, not smooth airbrushed masses.

[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
SOLAR RELIGHTING DIRECTIVE (5400K Clean standard daylight with distinct directional shadows):
- SUN POSITION IN SCREEN SPACE: Sun is located in the background to the upper-right (Azimuth 55.9°, Elevation 32.1°).
- FACADE ILLUMINATION: structures are backlit silhouettes with bright rim lighting along right edges; front facades are in soft skylight.
- CAST SHADOW DIRECTION: long cast shadows project forward toward the lower-LEFT of the frame.
- SHADOW OVERWRITE RULE: MANDATORY: Erase all sideways/rearward shadows; project all elongated shadows forward toward the lower-LEFT.
- WEATHER/SKY: Dense ground fog and mist with light-scattering depth haze and softened horizon contrast.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
High-angle architectural survey of Hanover Street and Rose Street junction, Edinburgh New Town. Center foreground features a Scots Baronial corner tenement of Dumfriesshire red sandstone ashlar and droved buff sandstone dressings, defined by a corbelled polygonal corner turret with conical slate cap, 4 storeys over commercial ground level, and a slate-clad mansard roof with zinc-cheeked pedimented dormers. Flanking terraces display Georgian Craigleith blonde sandstone ashlar facades, 3 to 4 storeys over rusticated basements with cast-iron spearhead railings.
